### Logo Usage Rules

- Always maintain clear space around the logo equal to the height of the "A" mark
- Minimum size: 30px height for digital, 10mm for print
- Never stretch, rotate, or alter the proportions of the logo
- Never place the logo on busy or low-contrast backgrounds
- Always use provided logo files — never recreate the mark

### Colour Usage

- **Primary Navy** — Backgrounds, headings, text, navbar, footer, hero sections
- **Gold Accent** — CTAs, buttons, accent lines, highlights, hover states, statistics
- **Charcoal** — Body text, primary content text
- **Warm Grey** — Secondary text, descriptions, supporting copy (replaces raw `#666`)
- **Gold Tint** — Warm section backgrounds, testimonial sections, featured content areas
- **Light Grey** — Alternate section backgrounds
- **White** — Primary page backgrounds, text on dark backgrounds

### Montserrat {style="font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif;"}
**Headings & Wordmarks**

::: {style="font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif;"}
[Aa Bb Cc Dd Ee Ff Gg]{style="font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 700;"}

[Heading 1 — 3rem / 700]{style="font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; display: block; margin: 0.5rem 0;"}
[Heading 2 — 2.25rem / 700]{style="font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; display: block; margin: 0.5rem 0;"}
[Heading 3 — 1.5rem / 700]{style="font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 700; display: block; margin: 0.5rem 0;"}
[*Logo wordmarks use Bold Italic*]{style="font-weight: 700; font-style: italic; display: block; margin: 0.5rem 0;"}
:::

**Weights used:** 600 (Semi-Bold), 700 (Bold)
**Styles:** Regular, Italic (for logo wordmarks)

::::::
:::::: {.col-md-6}

### Inter {style="font-family: Inter, sans-serif;"}
**Body Text & UI**

::: {style="font-family: Inter, sans-serif;"}
[Aa Bb Cc Dd Ee Ff Gg]{style="font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 400;"}

[Body text at 1rem / 400 weight for comfortable reading across long paragraphs and descriptive content.]{style="font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; display: block; margin: 0.5rem 0; line-height: 1.7;"}

[**Medium weight (500)** for emphasis within body text, labels, and UI elements.]{style="font-size: 1rem; display: block; margin: 0.5rem 0;"}

[**Semi-Bold (600)** for buttons, navigation, and strong emphasis.]{style="font-size: 1rem; display: block; margin: 0.5rem 0;"}
:::

**Weights used:** 400 (Regular), 500 (Medium), 600 (Semi-Bold)

## Design Motifs {.mb-2}

::: {.gold-line}
:::

### Diagonal Cuts

The diagonal cut is a signature brand element, used on hero sections and transitions between content areas. It creates visual energy and movement.

::: {style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1B365D 0%, #0d1f38 100%); height: 120px; border-radius: 8px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; margin: 1.5rem 0;"}
::: {style="position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 40px; background: #F5F5F5; clip-path: polygon(0 100%, 100% 0, 100% 100%);"}
:::
:::

### Gold Accent Line

A gradient gold line used as a section divider and heading accent. 80px wide, 4px tall, with a subtle gradient for depth.

::: {.gold-line .mt-3 .mb-4}
:::

### Card Elevation & Hover

Interactive cards use subtle shadow and lift on hover with a gold left border reveal.

::::: {.row .g-4 .mt-3}
:::::: {.col-md-4}
::: {.service-card}
#### Example Card
Cards have a subtle shadow at rest and lift with a gold left border on hover. Try hovering over this card.
:::
::::::
:::::

### Scroll Animations

Content elements use scroll-triggered entrance animations for a polished, dynamic feel. Animation classes:

- `.fade-up` — Elements translate up 30px and fade in
- `.fade-in` — Elements fade in from transparent
- `.slide-in-left` — Elements slide in from the left
- `.slide-in-right` — Elements slide in from the right
- `.stagger-children` — Staggers animation timing for grid items

## Division Identity Rules {.mb-2}

::: {.gold-line}
:::

All divisions share the same "A" brand mark, colour palette, typography, and design motifs. Division differentiation comes **only** through the wordmark text below the icon.

### Consistent Elements (Never Change)

- The stylised "A" icon geometry
- The circular container around the "A"
- Montserrat Bold Italic for wordmark text
- Letter spacing and capitalization (all uppercase, tracked)
- Brand colours (#1B365D, #D4A843)

### Variable Elements

- Wordmark text: "ALLIED", "ALLIED LIFTING", "ALLIED LOGISTICS", "ALLIED SCAFFOLDING"
- Supporting descriptive tagline on division pages

### Division Taglines

- **Allied Lifting** — "Crane Operations & Lifting Services"
- **Allied Logistics** — "Construction Logistics Coordination"
- **Allied Scaffolding** — "Scaffolding Services"

## Photography Style {.mb-2}

::: {.gold-line}
:::

Photography is a critical brand element. Every page should feature real imagery that demonstrates capability, scale, and professionalism.

### Direction

- **Construction in progress** — Active sites showing cranes, logistics operations, scaffolding
- **High contrast, slightly desaturated** — Professional tone that doesn't feel like generic stock photography
- **Show scale and human activity** — Operatives demonstrating competence, equipment in action
- **London skyline context** — Establishing shots that place projects in their urban setting
- **Professional and clean** — Well-organised sites, proper PPE, clear skies where possible

### Image Treatment

- **Hero sections** — Full-bleed images with navy gradient overlay (85-93% opacity) for text legibility
- **Feature blocks** — Full-colour images with rounded corners and subtle shadow
- **Project cards** — Images with gradient overlay from bottom for text overlays
- **CTA banners** — Background images with darker navy overlay (92-95% opacity)
- **Division cards** — 200px height images at top of card with `object-fit: cover`

### Avoid

- Empty sites or inactive equipment
- Overly saturated or filtered images
- Poor weather unless editorially relevant
- Generic stock photography that could belong to any industry
